literal_status_warning: heartbeat=OK watchdog=OK are literal status strings and are not independently measured states

measurement_definitions.bad_crc_detection: first G431 PAYLOAD_REJECT reason=CRC after injection
measurement_definitions.delayed_detection: first G431 PAYLOAD_TIMEOUT or PAYLOAD_OFFLINE after injection; based on inspected 250 ms responder delay and 100 ms controller deadline
measurement_definitions.recovery_time_ms: G431 PAYLOAD_RECOVERED host time minus MODE NORMAL command-send host time; only populated when NORMAL confirmation is also observed
measurement_definitions.restart_marker: G431 PAYLOAD_LINK_START after injection; absence is not proof that no MCU reset occurred
measurement_definitions.silent_detection: first G431 PAYLOAD_TIMEOUT or PAYLOAD_OFFLINE after injection
